title: ocotea mayana
intro: Ocotea mayana, commonly known as the Mexican Prune or Mayan Pepper, is a tropical evergreen tree native to the tropical forests of Central America and Mexico. The health benefits of Ocotea mayana include its potential in supporting immune function and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpenes and alkaloids. Specifically, the bioactive constituents of Ocotea mayana include compounds like alpha-asaron, beta-asaron, and other sesquiterpenes that contribute to its medicinal properties.
